summary: CVC-PE Global Private Equity Fund, LP filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 disclosing the sale of unregistered limited partnership units in its continuous private offering for aggregate consideration of ~$55.4 million. The sales occurred on June 1, 2026, with final figures determined on June 25, 2026, based on May 29, 2026 Transactional NAV per unit ($108.19–$109.90). The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. This is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing private fund capital raises, not a special situation.
